products.before_excerpt:
Custom brown kraft bakery paper bags offer a practical open-top format for pastries, small loaves and bakery counter orders. The reference shows handleless bags with side gussets and a folded base, including an example display with croissants. Your bakery logo, dimensions and packing arrangement can be developed for a consistent supply across outlets or distributor customers.

Choose the specification around the real product: size, grease and moisture exposure, packing temperature and whether food contacts the paper directly. The images do not establish grease resistance or a food-contact grade. VPN Packaging Factory can review those requirements before a sample is approved. The general planning minimum is 1,000 units, with project minimums, price and packing confirmed in a written quotation. Send your email, artwork, quantity by size and destination to start. Design support and custom sampling are available, followed by production against the approved requirements.
